bug_description.normalized: The staged 72-byte ADTS/XAAC witness is admitted far enough into libxaac's MPS frame parser to reach `ixheaacd_parse_extension_frame()`. At lines 684-687, that function selects the residual AAC sampling-rate index `sfidx` from either `bs_arbitrary_downmix_residual_sampling_freq_index` or `bs_residual_sampling_freq_index` depending on `pstr_mps_state->arbitrary_downmix == 2`. The saved UBSan artifacts prove only the selected value that reaches the crash: `p_ics_info->sampling_rate_index == 14`; they do not statically identify which upstream config field supplied it. `ixheaacd_parse_extension_frame()` stores that selected `14` into channel 0 `ics_info.sampling_rate_index`, residual ICS parsing later materializes `tns_data_present == 1`, and `ixheaacd_parse_residual_data()` therefore calls `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` on the same channel info. `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` does not validate `sampling_rate_index` before asking `ixheaacd_res_get_maximum_tns_bands()` to index `tns_max_bands_tbl[p_ics_info->sampling_rate_index][i]`. Because `ixheaacd_mps_res_rom.h` declares that table as `WORD8[12][2]`, the witnessed first index `14` is out of bounds and UBSan reports the saved crash at `decoder/ixheaacd_mps_res_pns_js_thumb.c:42`.

source.description: First statically closed project statement that consumes attacker-tainted MPS config state and materializes the residual AAC sampling-rate index actually used by the crashing path.
source.value_from: The staged `poc` (SHA-256 `ec61693962bbe530bdeda63535be8fa6d69b26e7ff78ffb9e188192e190c0a3d`) is the only saved witness. The UBSan report proves the value that reaches the sink is `p_ics_info->sampling_rate_index == 14`. Because runtime disambiguation is disabled and the selector at lines 684-687 can choose either candidate config field, this selector is the first exact project statement that the staged artifacts statically close.

sink.description: UBSan crash site. The helper uses `sampling_rate_index == 14` as the first index into `tns_max_bands_tbl`, whose type is `WORD8[12][2]`.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `runtime error: index 14 out of bounds for type 'WORD8[12][2]'` at this statement.

root_cause.description: Missing bounds check before TNS-band lookup. Once `tns_data_present` is true, `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` forwards `p_ics_info` into `ixheaacd_res_get_maximum_tns_bands()` without validating that `sampling_rate_index` is within the residual TNS-table limit `0..11`.
root_cause.note: The fix resolves this by constraining both upstream parser assignments to `<= MAX_RES_SAMP_FREQ_IDX (11)`, preventing either selector arm from supplying an invalid row index.

parser_admitted.description: After earlier AAC/MPS frame parsing succeeds, the staged witness enters `ixheaacd_parse_extension_frame()`, the function that selects the residual AAC sampling-rate index and later dispatches the crashing residual-data extension.

tainted_value_origin.description: First durable channel-info state carrying the selected witness index. In this residual-MPS path, line 694 is the only assignment to `ics_info.sampling_rate_index` before the sink, so the selected `14` persists into later TNS processing.

evidence_limitations: `run_flags.json` sets `runtime_disambiguation` to false, so Stage 02 did not instrument the selector at `decoder/ixheaacd_mps_bitdec.c:684-687`.

The saved artifacts prove only the selected sink value `sampling_rate_index == 14`; they do not statically distinguish whether that `14` came from `bs_residual_sampling_freq_index` or `bs_arbitrary_downmix_residual_sampling_freq_index`. The trace therefore anchors taint at the selector and the durable channel-info assignment, not at either upstream parser assignment.
Stage 02 did not run the fixed build. `patch_resolves` is source-grounded from `patch.diff`, which adds the missing `> 11` rejection after both candidate producer assignments.

coarse_trace.summary: Earlier MPS config parsing populates the selector inputs `bs_residual_sampling_freq_index`, `bs_arbitrary_downmix_residual_sampling_freq_index`, and `arbitrary_downmix`; the staged artifacts do not statically disambiguate which candidate field later supplies the witnessed `sfidx = 14`.
`ixheaacd_parse_extension_frame()` selects the actually used residual sampling-rate index `sfidx = 14` and stores it into channel 0 `ics_info.sampling_rate_index`.
Residual ICS parsing reads `tns_data_present = 1`, so control enters `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` on the same channel-info object without validating `sampling_rate_index <= 11`.
The TNS helper indexes `tns_max_bands_tbl[14][i]` on a `WORD8[12][2]` table and UBSan reports the saved index-out-of-bounds at line 42.

fine_trace.note: Source. `ixheaacd_parse_extension_frame()` selects the residual AAC sampling-rate index from one of two previously parsed config fields. The saved UBSan artifacts prove the selected value that reaches the sink is `14`, but with runtime disambiguation disabled they do not establish which selector arm supplied it.

The selected `sfidx` becomes durable channel-info state for residual decoding. In this residual-MPS path, line 694 is the only assignment to `ics_info.sampling_rate_index` before the crash, so the witness value `14` survives into later residual ICS and TNS processing.

Residual ICS parsing materializes the one-bit TNS-present flag from attacker-controlled bits in the same channel-info object. The later crashing call proves this flag is `1` for channel 0 on the witness.

The residual-data parser takes the `tns_data_present` branch and calls `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` with the same channel-info structure that still carries `sampling_rate_index = 14`. The saved crash stack contains this call at `ixheaacd_parse_residual_data:603`.

Root cause. Once TNS is present, `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` immediately asks the helper for `tns_max_bands` using `p_ics_info` and performs no check that `p_ics_info->sampling_rate_index` fits the residual TNS table's 12 rows. The selected witness value `14` therefore reaches the helper unchecked.

The helper dereferences row `14` of `tns_max_bands_tbl`, but `ixheaacd_mps_res_rom.h:27` declares the table as `WORD8 tns_max_bands_tbl[12][2]`, so valid first-dimension rows are only `0..11`. `i` is `0` or `1` depending on window sequence, but the first index is already out of bounds.

format.contract: An input that is admitted through libxaac's MPS frame parser, reaches `ixheaacd_parse_extension_frame()` with the selected residual AAC sampling-rate index `sfidx == 14`, then yields `tns_data_present == 1` for the residual ICS so `ixheaacd_res_ctns_apply()` calls `ixheaacd_res_get_maximum_tns_bands()` on channel info whose `sampling_rate_index` remains `14`.
